verdict.rationale: Automated CI testing and simulation-based regression testing are a fair question for a robot software and fleet platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Formant offering CI test runners, simulation environments, or regression testing. Docker agent install, run_script commands, and SDKs are adjacent building blocks for running scripts on devices, not a testing capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run automated tests of robot software in CI, including simulation-based regression tests
